name: marco-vrinssen
description: Claude Code plugins by Marco Vrinssen.

plugins.name: video-reader
plugins.description: Reads YouTube videos through their transcript, chapters and metadata with yt-dlp, and samples still frames for on-screen content. Summarizes, answers questions and cites timestamps.

plugins.name: resume-ai-optimizer
plugins.description: Optimizes resumes for AI-screened hiring. Checks that screening software can read the PDF, maps the resume to a job description without keyword stuffing, rewrites bullets into quantified XYZ achievements without inventing facts, and shows AI skills through proof.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Flag-driven text transformation. One flag fixes, translates, sharpens, shortens, lists or humanizes text, or turns it into a prompt for Claude. Keeps the input's language and meaning.

plugins.name: namefinder
plugins.description: Generates brand, product, project and character names from sound symbolism, tuned to your taste.

plugins.name: maccheck
plugins.description: Checks why a Mac is slow, full or at risk with read-only checks, reports numbered fixes and applies only the fixes you confirm.

plugins.name: financial-analysis
plugins.description: Investment research for private investors in Germany. Turns a ticker, ISIN, ETF, theme, pitch or stock tip into a sourced report with a buy, watch or avoid verdict.

plugins.name: wow-addon-dev
plugins.description: World of Warcraft addon and WeakAura development. Verifies every API against the matching flavor branch of Blizzard's UI source, covers Midnight secret values, and builds ready-to-paste WeakAura import strings.
